definitions.explanation: A starchy root vegetable with sweet flesh, widely grown and eaten in Japan. Named after Satsuma (present-day Kagoshima), through which it was introduced to Japan.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}きいも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さつまいも⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Sweet potatoes are used for yaki-imo (roasted sweet potatoes).

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、さつまいも⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Sweet potatoes become delicious in autumn.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧さつまいも{掘|ほ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいた→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: The children were enjoying digging up sweet potatoes in the field.

notes:
Written in kanji as {薩摩芋|さつまいも}. Named after {薩摩|さつま} (present-day Kagoshima Prefecture), through which the sweet potato was introduced to Japan.

COMMON DISHES:
- {焼|や}きいも: roasted sweet potato
- {大学芋|だいがくいも}: candied sweet potato
- スイート⟦ポテト→ポテト：11170_poteto⟧: sweet potato dessert
- さつまいも⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: sweet potato tempura

CULTURE: A beloved autumn delicacy. Sweet potato digging (いも⟦{掘|ほ}り→掘る：00442_horu⟧) is a classic activity at kindergartens and elementary schools.
